findings.title: Non-finite persisted DHW cooling rate reaches the live model, never reset
findings.claim: A DHW-profile store whose cooling_rate is NaN installs a non-finite value on the live ThermalModel.params.dhw_cooling_rate that is never quarantined or reset and emits no log line, so ThermalModel.dhw_hold_hours() and the published payload are non-finite too and the next save writes NaN back.
findings.mechanism: DhwProfileLearner.async_load_profile parses the stored rate with float(rate) under (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError); float('nan') raises nothing. DhwProfileLearner.apply_cooling_rate is float(np.clip(rate, MIN, MAX)) and np.clip propagates NaN. The four sibling learned scalars dispatched from _async_load_thermal_learning are each wrapped in coordinator:_refuses_non_finite, whose docstring names this exact hazard; this fifth seam of that family is the one without the guard. The learner's own EWMA (1-a)*self.cooling_rate + a*observed then absorbs NaN on every later fold, so the corruption is self-perpetuating.

evidence.machine: Apple M1, 8 GB, macOS 25.6.0, shared audit box
evidence.contention_note: fan-out: shared with the other round-6 auditors, load1 74.97; the metric is a count, which contention cannot move

perturbation.change: Wrap DhwProfileLearner.apply_cooling_rate so a non-finite argument is dropped instead of clamped (the guard coordinator:_refuses_non_finite already gives the four sibling learned scalars); the harness applies it by monkey-patch and reverts it in a finally.

findings.metric_definition: Non-finite values among DhwProfileLearner.cooling_rate, ThermalModel.params.dhw_cooling_rate, ThermalModel.dhw_hold_hours(), data['dhw_cooling_rate'] and data['dhw_hold_hours'] after the reload.

null_control.note: The healthy payload's own rate and 0.42 both give nonfinite_live=0 and resaved_finite=True; the count is a property of the corrupt input, not of the load path.

reproduction_steps: Read RESULT nonfinite_live (5) beside RESULT nonfinite_live_perturbed (0).
findings.proposed_fix_scope: One finiteness guard in DhwProfileLearner.apply_cooling_rate (drop a non-finite rate, leaving the previous finite value in place, log once) plus the same test in async_load_profile. Healthy path byte-identical; no golden fixture should move.

findings.title: Non-finite persisted defrost duty silently becomes the floor derate
findings.claim: A NaN in one cell of the accuracy store's defrost.duty survives DefrostDerate.from_dict, is never quarantined or reset, emits no log line, and makes ThermalModel.compute_cop price every step in that temperature/humidity bucket at 0.55x the healthy COP, permanently.
findings.mechanism: DefrostDerate.from_dict builds both grids through a shared local _grid_of(key, cast) helper that does cast(v) for v in row with no finiteness test. The sibling grid 'factors' is re-clamped with min(DERATE_MAX, max(DERATE_MIN, v)) on the next lines, which returns a bound (not NaN) for NaN, so factors is safe by accident; duty gets no such clamp, and float('nan') raises nothing. The reader derate_from_duty's min(max(float(duty), 0.0), DEFROST_DUTY_MAX) also returns a bound for NaN, so the NaN becomes DERATE_MIN = 0.55 rather than a NaN and the failure is silent. A bucket only needs duty_counts[t][h] >= 1 for the measured estimator to be consulted in _decide.

evidence.machine: Apple M1, 8 GB, macOS 25.6.0, shared audit box
evidence.contention_note: fan-out: shared with the other round-6 auditors, load1 70.65; the metric is a ratio against the healthy store measured in the same process, which contention cancels

perturbation.change: Add the finiteness test that the sibling 'factors' grid gets by accident to _grid_of's 'duty' call in DefrostDerate.from_dict (v if math.isfinite(v) else 0.0), applied by monkey-patch and reverted in a finally.

findings.metric_definition: ThermalModel.compute_cop(T, H) at the poisoned bucket after loading the corrupted accuracy store, divided by the same call from the same code with a healthy store.

null_control.note: The healthy payload through the same loader gives cop_ratio_null_control=1.000000 and nonfinite_duty_live=0; the ratio is a property of the corrupt cell, not of the measurement.

reproduction_steps: Read RESULT cop_ratio (0.550000) beside RESULT cop_ratio_perturbed (1.000000) and RESULT cop_ratio_null_control (1.000000).
findings.proposed_fix_scope: One finiteness test in DefrostDerate.from_dict's duty grid (v if math.isfinite(v) else 0.0), matching what factors gets by accident and duty_counts gets for free. No golden fixture should move.
